name: Orion the Oracle
source:
The carnival comes to town every year without fail. 

But there's something different this time; an attraction. 

Meet Orion the Oracle. 

He is a stranger on all accounts. 

Yet, he knows you.

[From [url=https://inkedvision.itch.io/orion-the-oracle]itch.io[/url]]
